asset.name: ResizeHandle
asset.description: The separator affordance itself: a pointer target wider than the seam it draws, with focus, drag, snap and collapse states, on either logical axis.

requires.reason: Pointer math, keyboard operation, clamping and persistence belong to the hook, not to the affordance.
The hit-target size, seam colour, focus ring and motion all resolve to declared ramps.

rationale: Separating the affordance from the region it resizes is what lets one implementation serve a sidebar, a split pane and a terminal grid. The hit target must be far wider than the visible seam, and that width has to be the same number the resize arithmetic reserves — keeping both in one token is the whole reason this is a component rather than a class list.
